segments.an5.60:1.3: Dullabho, bhikkhave, vuḍḍhapabbajito suvaco, dullabho suggahitaggāhī, dullabho padakkhiṇaggāhī, dullabho dhammakathiko, dullabho vinayadharo.
segments.an5.60:1.4: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato dullabho vuḍḍhapabbajito”ti.
segments.an5.60:2.3: Upajjhā ṭhānā licchavi, kumārā aparā duveti.
